atoms.a: You can drink coffee or tea here and talk with your friends.

You can eat lunch or dinner here. Waiters bring the food to your table.
Children learn new things here every day.
You can take a walk here and enjoy the trees and the fresh air.
Doctors and nurses work here and help ill people get better.
You can buy popcorn and watch new films here.
